Archive SHA256: 172708123daa0c98d20d3a980b16a50be14af243dc95dee6f79c24193ad010e4
Only include/, src/ and LICENSE.txt were copied.
Local change (1.3 T6, S-water-01): trampoline blocks are never
PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE at rest. src/buffer.c: GetMemoryBlock allocates a new
block PAGE_READWRITE, builds the slot list, then sets PAGE_EXECUTE_READ;
AllocateBuffer write-enables the block (PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE, never plain RW:
it may hold another live trampoline) and leaves it so for the caller's
trampoline write; new ProtectBuffer(LPVOID) re-protects PAGE_EXECUTE_READ and
flushes the instruction cache; FreeBuffer write-enables around its list
updates (also the previous block's pNext) and re-protects unless the block is
VirtualFree'd. src/buffer.h declares ProtectBuffer. src/hook.c MH_CreateHook
calls ProtectBuffer right after CreateTrampolineFunction succeeds. Why: an RWX
region at rest is a writable+executable target for any memory-corruption bug
in the host process. Hook, fallback and API behaviour are unchanged.
The LLVM-only build supplies a local __movsb compatibility routine in its own
build output, rather than modifying upstream MinHook source.
